name: Personal Murder Theater: Raíces Estranguladas
source:
You and your wife, Daniela, decide to visit Jimena (Daniela’s twin sister) following the tragic and sudden death of her husband. However, the moment you shake her hand, you notice her strange behavior—more erratic than ever.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3584380/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在丈夫不幸突然去世后，你和你的妻子丹妮拉 (Daniela) 决定去看望希梅纳 (Jimena)（丹妮拉的双胞胎妹妹）。然而，当你和她握手的那一刻，你注意到她的奇怪行为——比以往任何时候都更加不稳定。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3584380/]Steam[/url]]
